items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Jean-Marc Shimonga; the interviewer identifies Shimonga as the engineer for the session.

ctx.x: My name is Bill Brower. I am interviewing Frank Foster for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program. The date is November 22, 1998, and serving as engineer for this session is Jean-Marc Shimonga. Maybe at this point a general comment about what your desires and motivations and plans were, what your objectives were, at the point you decided to leave the Basie band. What you saw for yourself. Then you could flow into how you have realized some of the things that you wanted to do at the point you decided that it…
One of the primary motivating factors was a desire to be with my then-family. That was the family by my first marriage. I had two young sons.
